constraints: load_policy on a `[source] kind="github_review"` + source.repo file resolves source_kind == "github_review" and build_work_source returns a GithubReviewWorkSource bound to that repo and the operator's default graders (criterion #8).
`kind = "github_review"` without source.repo raises PolicyError naming the missing repo key (criterion #9).

Driven through the orchestrator, an unresolved-thread item reaches DONE only when the operator's graders pass when run OUT-OF-BAND by the harness; the compiled Task carries no grader derived from isResolved, and an unresolved thread whose default graders pass still reaches DONE with no resolve mutation issued (D-4, criterion #5).
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do NOT read or trust the thread's isResolved state as the grade (D-4) -- the grade is the harness's out-of-band default graders plus 00051's held-out gate when configured.
Do NOT resolve or mutate a review thread anywhere on the drive/landing path.
Do NOT add a review-specific store or reconcile path -- reuse the existing sync_work_source / reconcile_live_runs unchanged.
Do NOT change the issue, CI, or directory source behavior.
Do NOT modify files under tests/ to weaken or delete assertions.
edge_cases: A flywheel.toml with kind=github_review + repo loads and builds a GithubReviewWorkSource; missing repo -> PolicyError (criteria #8, #9).
An existing directory/github/github_ci policy file still loads unchanged (no regression).
agent reports DONE while the out-of-band graders fail -> NOT DONE (the grade is the graders, not the agent or thread resolution).
An unresolved thread with passing default graders is driven to DONE and the harness issues no resolve mutation (criterion #5, the headline anti-hack).
